name: opengecko-source-backed-provider-target-presets
description: Starter presets for optional source-backed sync jobs beyond market charts. Presets are bounded examples for improving coverage diagnostics; credentials and upstream adapters stay outside OpenGecko.

presets.priority: Use after market chart/OHLCV freshness is stable; verifies exchange volume chart source rows before relying on retained public volume_chart history.
Use for futures/swap ticker, funding, and open-interest source rows; seeded derivative fixtures remain fallback until these venues ingest successfully.
Use for source-attributed pool trades before expanding holder/trader analytics; synthetic trades must remain fallback-only.
Preferred chart/OHLC route because it follows the coverage target manifest and history backfill planner instead of a hand-maintained target string.

operator_notes: Run each sync command standalone first, then compare diagnostics before enabling OPTIONAL_PROVIDER_SYNC_ENABLED.
Do not interpret replay fixtures as live production coverage; they prove adapter contracts and route fallback shape.
Promote coverage only from diagnostics deltas: source rows written, stale/shallow gaps reduced, and coverage_matrix ownership gates satisfied.
